narration: Exactly how warm it gets inside depends on the snow, the wind, and the weather outside, there's no single fixed number. Back on the sea ice, that hunter isn't just cutting blocks, he's building a wall of trapped air to keep his own warmth from escaping. Your coat does the same job tonight, and so does the glass in your window. Warmth doesn't need walls of stone. It just needs air that can't move.
